title: Sepsis prognosis in the ICU
summary: Candidate design coordinates for prognosis after a reproducible sepsis landmark. The card does not authorize a sepsis label, cohort exclusion, mortality horizon, or causal interpretation without matching typed variables and the user's question.

design_candidates.population: ICU patients meeting a reproducible, data-observable sepsis definition; distinguish general sepsis from septic shock when the question requires it.
design_candidates.time_zero: First qualifying sepsis landmark or ICU admission, chosen before exposure assessment and outcomes.
design_candidates.observation_window: Baseline physiology, organ dysfunction, treatment, and measurement-process variables available by the declared landmark.
design_candidates.prediction_or_followup_window: In-hospital or prespecified fixed-horizon follow-up with discharge and censoring defined explicitly.
eligibility_candidates: Prevent duplicate stays from crossing validation sets
Separate prevalent from incident sepsis when relevant
design_candidates.exposure: Question-specific baseline severity, biomarker, treatment, or predictor set measured before or at the landmark.
design_candidates.outcome: Prespecified mortality or organ-support outcome with a defined horizon and ascertainment source.
design_candidates.estimand: Association, survival probability, or prognostic risk at the declared horizon for the target sepsis population.
recommended_methods: Model outcome type and censoring explicitly
Report absolute risks with adjusted estimates
sensitivity_analyses: Alternative sepsis landmark or operational definition

stop_conditions: A reproducible sepsis landmark cannot be constructed
Exposure is measured after the outcome window begins without an explicit landmark design
requires_confirmation: Confirm the operational sepsis or septic-shock definition and landmark
Confirm whether the task is descriptive, prognostic, or treatment-effect estimation
